what: The Cooking Converter is three kitchen tools in one. The ingredient converter changes cups, spoons, milliliters, grams, ounces and pounds using the density of common ingredients like flour, sugar, butter, rice and milk.
The oven converter changes temperatures between °C, °F, fan (convection) and gas mark. The recipe scaler multiplies a pasted ingredient list for more or fewer servings.
uses: Turn US cups into grams or metric cups.
Get grams for flour, sugar and butter.
Scale a recipe from 4 to 6 servings in one step.
Set new servings to half to cut every amount.
tutorial: Type it in "Amount", for example 2, 1.5, 3/4 or 1 1/2.
Pick the unit and the ingredient, such as "Flour, all-purpose / plain".
Pick US, metric, Australian or old UK cups and spoons.
The big line shows the main answer and the boxes show every unit.
Type a temperature, pick °C, °F or gas mark, and say whether the recipe is for a fan oven.
Enter "Recipe makes" and "I want" servings and paste your ingredients one per line. Copy the scaled list.
features: Flours, sugars, butter, oil, honey, rice, oats, milk, cream and more.
US, metric, Australian and old UK.
ml, l, tsp, tbsp, cups, US and UK fl oz and pints, g, kg, oz and lb.
Gas marks 1/4 to 10 with °C, fan and °F.
Reads 1 1/2, ½ and ranges like 1-2, and writes kitchen fractions back.

example.title: Worked examples
example.text: 1 US cup of all-purpose flour is about 125 g; 200 g of sugar is about 1 US cup. 180 °C is 356 °F, gas mark 4, or 160 °C in a fan oven. Scaling from 4 to 6 servings multiplies by 1.5: "2 cups flour" becomes "3 cups flour" and "1 1/2 tsp baking powder" becomes "2 1/4 tsp".

tips: Spoon flour into the cup and level it; scooping packs in more.
Use weights for baking when you can.
Round scaled eggs sensibly, or beat and measure part of an egg.
Baking times and pan sizes may change when you scale a recipe.
problems: Use numbers and fractions only, like 1 1/2 or 0.5, without units.
Only numbers at the start of a line are scaled. Tick the box to scale numbers later in the line too.
